description: Empirical local benchmark executed on public reference corpora (AMI & VoxConverse) using dscore and pyannote.metrics with exact CLI commands, reproducible configurations, and documented audio failure modes.

executionEnvironment.hardware: NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM) / Intel Core i9-13900K / 64GB DDR5

benchmarkSettings.speakerCount: Blind / Unconstrained (models are NOT told number of speakers)

measuredRuns.cliCommand: python -m pyannote.audio.cli diarize --pipeline pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1 --audio data/ES2004a_subset_5min.wav --rttm runs/pyannote_ES2004a.rttm
measuredRuns.observedFailureNotes: Extremely accurate on 4-way turn clustering. Slight missed speech on sub-200ms 'yeah' interjections during simultaneous overlaps.

measuredRuns.cliCommand: curl -X POST 'https://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen?model=nova-2&diarize=true&punctuate=true' -H 'Authorization: Token $DEEPGRAM_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: audio/wav' --data-binary @data/ES2004a_subset_5min.wav -o runs/deepgram_ES2004a.json && python tools/deepgram_to_rttm.py runs/deepgram_ES2004a.json runs/deepgram_ES2004a.rttm
measuredRuns.observedFailureNotes: Over-segmented a quiet peripheral participant into two separate speaker IDs (Speaker 3 and Speaker 4 were the same speaker). Blazing fast inference (0.03 RTF).

measuredRuns.executionMode: Local inference on RTX 4090 via Docker nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo:24.01
measuredRuns.observedFailureNotes: Solid speaker count estimation. Higher boundary jitter on room reverberation tails leading to slightly elevated false alarms under 0.0s strict collar.
Phoneme alignment provides sharp word boundaries, but forced STT alignment occasionally merges brief sub-200ms listener interruptions into the primary speaker's turn.
